text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Objection!! Right now, the 
defendant's explanation—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
choice_data_list: So, what kind of dream was it?
So, what were you dreaming about?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Guh... Well, you know that courtroom drama 
everyone's been talking about lately? 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...No, spare me any more of this, please. 
I've reflected on what I did. That, 
well... I made a fool of myself."

However, ten minutes later, her cry of 
"Objection!" echoed through the room once 
more... It seems she truly is not getting 
enough sleep.
